skills.detail:
When your team's Treasure Area is being captured:
A long-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.
Also, a multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor to enemies around your team's closest Treasure Area that is being captured by the enemy (up to 1 spot).

When your team's Treasure Area is not being captured:
A long-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.

Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.
skills.name: If You Have a Death Wish, Step Forward!

skills.detail:
When You Have a Treasure Area:
A mid-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.
Also, a multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor to enemies around your captured Treasure, and creates a shield in the Treasure Area that blocks enemies' attacks and movement (up to 5 spots).
The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes.

When You Have No Treasure Area:
A mid-range multiple hit area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Out of My Way!
